item.blurb: Edelbyte Raises $70M in Funding. Edelbyte emerges from stealth with $70 million in seed and Series A funding led by Sequoia and Quiet Capital to power AI agent data analytics.
Opdo Raises $2.3M Pre-seed. Opdo raises $2.3M in pre-seed funding led by Angular Ventures to automate optical engineering workflows with its AI-driven design and simulation platform.
Twin1 AI Raises $5M Seed Extension. Twin1 AI raises $5 million in a seed extension round led by Curql to expand its AI-powered digital twin platform for regulated enterprise industries.
Qvyon Technologies Raises $8M Seed. Montréal-based Qvyon Technologies raises $8M in seed funding to expand its AI-driven simulation and validation software for robotics and autonomous vehicles.
Mount Thor Raises $45M Series A. Mount Thor raises $45M in funding to expand its cloud infrastructure, providing on-demand access to Apple silicon for AI agent development.
XpertDox Raises $20M Series A. XpertDox raises $20M in Series A funding led by Savant Growth to scale its autonomous AI medical coding platform for healthcare providers.
Q-CTRL Raises $290M Series C. Q-CTRL raises $290M in a Series C round led by Salesforce Ventures to expand its AI-powered quantum infrastructure software and global operations.
Databento Raises $100M Series C. Databento raises $100 million Series C led by Fifth Down Capital at a $1.1 billion valuation to expand its financial market data platform infrastructure.
Delphina Raises $7.5M in Funding. Delphina raises $7.5 million in a funding round led by Radical Ventures and Costanoa to scale its AI-driven business analytics and Context Factory platform.
